inputs.meanvarmarker_map: float32 [B,3,51,51]: channel 0 = (mean - mean_center)/mean_scale, 1 = (variance - var_center)/var_scale, 2 = one-hot agent cell

outputs.mixture_logits: float32 [B,K]: unnormalized log-weights; pi = softmax over K
outputs.component_waypoints_normalized: float32 [B,K,3,8]: mean trajectory of each component, the 8 control waypoints with xyz normalized to [-1,1]

world.marker: one cell at round((xy / xy_scale) * 50) clamped to 0..50; row = y, column = x

policy.use: ONE network call per plan. pi = softmax(mixture_logits). A plan is ONE component's waypoints: argmax(pi) (deterministic) or a component drawn with probability pi (what the PyTorch planner does by default). meters = clamp(denormalize(waypoints)): x, y = (v + 1) * xy_scale / 2 clamped to 0..xy_scale; z = (v + 1) * (z_max - z_min) / 2 + z_min clamped to z_min..z_max. The component scales are not exported (unused at flight time). See onnx_reference.py.
